extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants, attorneys, agents, and practitioners requesting USPTO Track One prioritized examination
extracted.subtask_description: Requirements and certifications for filing a USPTO Track One (prioritized examination) request under 37 CFR 1.102(e), covering fee payment, claim limits, application type and filing method, RCE-specific conditions, signature rules, and consequences for missing information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fee payment certification
rubrics_metrics.description: The processing fee set forth in 37 CFR 1.17(i)(1) and the prioritized examination fee set forth in 37 CFR 1.17(c) have been filed with the request. The publication fee requirement is met because that fee, set forth in 37 CFR 1.18(d), is currently $0. The basic filing fee, search fee, and examination fee are filed with the request or have been already been paid. I understand that any required excess claims fees or application size fee must be paid for the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All applicable fees (processing fee, prioritized examination fee, basic filing, search, examination) must accompany the request or already be paid. Applicant must also be aware and pay any excess claims fees and application size fee as required. Citations: 37 CFR 1.17(i)(1), 1.17(c), 1.18(d).

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims and amendment limits
rubrics_metrics.description: I understand that the application may not contain, or be amended to contain, more than four independent claims, more than thirty total claims, or any multiple dependent claims, and that any request for an extension of time will cause an outstanding Track I request to be dismissed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track One eligibility requires strict claim-count and claim-type limits: ≤4 independent claims, ≤30 total claims, and no multiple dependent claims. Filing or amending to exceed these limits will violate the certification. Additionally, requests for extensions of time will result in dismissal of an outstanding Track One request.

rubrics_metrics.name: Original application eligibility (Track One § 1.102(e)(1))
rubrics_metrics.description: This certification and request is being filed with the utility application via USPTO patent electronic filing system OR the application is an original nonprovisional plant application filed under 35 U.S.C. 111(a) and the certification is filed with the plant application in paper.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For original-application Track One requests: the application must be an original nonprovisional utility or plant application filed under 35 U.S.C. 111(a). Utility applications should use the USPTO electronic filing system; plant applications may be filed in paper per form instructions. An executed inventor’s oath or declaration under 37 CFR 1.63 or 1.64, or an application data sheet meeting 37 CFR 1.53(f)(3)(i) conditions, must be filed with the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request for Continued Examination (RCE) eligibility (Track One § 1.102(e)(2))
rubrics_metrics.description: A request for continued examination has been filed with, or prior to, this form. If the application is a utility application, this certification and request is being filed via USPTO patent electronic filing system. The application is an original nonprovisional utility application filed under 35 U.S.C. 111(a), or is a national stage entry under 35 U.S.C. 371. This certification and request is being filed prior to the mailing of a first Office action responsive to the request for continued examination. No prior request for continued examination has been granted prioritized examination status under 37 CFR 1.102(e)(2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: RCE Track One requests have additional timing and status requirements: the RCE must be filed with or before this form; the request must be filed prior to the first Office action responsive to the RCE; the underlying application must be an eligible utility or national-stage application; and the same application must not have already received prioritized status for a prior RCE. Utility filings should be submitted via EFS-Web as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Signature and practitioner information
rubrics_metrics.description: Signature: This form must be signed in accordance with 37 CFR 1.33. See 37 CFR 1.4(d) for signature requirements and certifications. Submit multiple forms if more than one signature is required. Provide name (print/typed), date, and practitioner registration number where applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the signature complies with applicable CFR rules (1.33 and 1.4(d)). If multiple signatories are necessary, submit multiple signed forms. Include practitioner registration number for practitioner signers. Unsigned or improperly signed forms may be deficient.

rubrics_metrics.name: Privacy Act / Required information and consequences
rubrics_metrics.description: If you do not furnish the information requested on this form, the USPTO may not be able to process and/or examine your submission, which may result in termination of proceedings, abandonment of the application, and/or expiration of the patent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Privacy Act Statement explains uses of collected information and warns that failure to provide required information can prevent processing or examination. Applicants should furnish all requested data to avoid adverse procedural consequences.
